summary: iSpecimen Inc. filed an 8-K reporting a 1-for-40 reverse stock split, effective April 27, 2026, approved by shareholders on October 30, 2025 and by the board on April 9, 2026. No fractional shares were issued; fractional shares were rounded up. Pre-split shares outstanding were 52,639,796; post-split approximately 1,316,032. The split aims to increase the per-share trading price to maintain Nasdaq listing compliance. This corporate action is a capital structure adjustment, not an event-driven special situation; no merger, tender offer, activist campaign, or strategic change is involved. Watch for potential delisting if price fails to hold above minimum bid requirement.
